title: Domain event
description: The envelope of one domain event, as stored in the transactional outbox and published to the event stream. Domain events record facts about state changes, such as a stage run passing. They are not diagnostic logs. Delivery is at least once, so a consumer must treat event_id as its idempotency key and ignore an event it has already handled. Heartbeats are not domain events.

event_id.description: Unique per event. Used as the stream message id for publish de-duplication and as the consumer idempotency key.

event_type.description: aggregate.past_tense_verb, taken from the emits column of state-machine.json.

event_version.description: Version of the payload shape for this event type.

version.description: Aggregate version after the change. Lets a consumer detect reordering and gaps.

transition_id.description: The transition in state-machine.json that produced the event. This is the machine-readable reason.

correlation_id.description: Shared by every event and log line that belongs to one job.

causation_id.description: The event or command that caused this one. Null for the first event of a job.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context value, so a consumer can continue the trace.

uuid.description: Lowercase UUID. Version 7 is recommended so identifiers sort by creation time.

timestamp.description: UTC instant in RFC 3339 form with a Z suffix.

slug.description: Machine-safe identifier: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. For metadata fields, never for human-facing titles.
